shorts.title: What REALLY Crashed at Roswell? 👽 Case #3
shorts.description:
A New Mexico rancher rode out across his ranch, and found shiny wreckage scattered all over the ground. Project Mogul's balloon trains carried microphones to listen for Soviet nuclear tests. The Air Force's reports came out in 1994 and 1997.

#shorts #meatballinvestigates #weirdhistory #mystery #meatballmyths

shorts.title: This Beetle Survives Being Run Over by a Car 🪲
shorts.description:
A scientist drove a car right over a tiny beetle. It got up and walked away. The diabolical ironclad beetle's shell takes about 39,000 times its body weight; its wing cases lock together with jigsaw-like joints.

#animalfacts #meatballmyths

Photos (iNaturalist (research-grade, CC0/CC BY)), cropped and color-adjusted: Phloeodes diabolicus: CC0, Tom and T Herman (CC BY), Nicole (CC BY), Hydrocycler (Elizabeth Dougherty) (CC BY), mel letterman (CC BY), Mark Valen (CC BY). creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0 · creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0
shorts.comment: What would you make uncrushable? 🪲 phone / 🚗 car / 🍝 me

shorts.title: Stonefish Are the Most Venomous Fish, and They Look Like Rocks 🪨
shorts.description:
I stepped on a rock in a coral reef. Then the rock stung me. First aid: get out of the water, soak in hot water (about 40-45 °C), get to hospital. An antivenom exists.

#animalfacts #meatballmyths

shorts.comment: Would you have spotted it? 👀 yes / 🪨 no way

shorts.title: Yes, It Can Actually Rain Spiders 🕷️ (Meatball vs Spiders #2)
shorts.description:
A baby spider climbed to the tip of a leaf, pointed its butt at the sky, and took off. In 2018, scientists showed spiders balloon on electric fields alone, with no wind at all.

#animalfacts #meatballmyths

shorts.comment: Would you still go outside? 👍 yes / 👎 no

shorts.title: Moray Eels Have a Second Set of Jaws 🦷
shorts.description:
A moray eel shot out of a crack in the reef and snapped up a fish in a flash. Moray eels launch a second set of jaws from the throat to drag prey down (Mehta & Wainwright 2007, Nature).

#animalfacts #meatballmyths

shorts.title: Operation Northwoods: The Conspiracy That Was TRUE 🔍 Case #2
shorts.description:
America's top general signed a plan to blow up an American ship, and blame it on Cuba. One idea in the plan: fake the shoot-down of a civilian airliner with a remote-controlled drone. The memo was declassified in 1997.

#shorts #meatballinvestigates #weirdhistory #mystery #meatballmyths
